'''Guy Lapidge''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Hutton tournament]] on 26 August 2001, according to Neil Goodacre's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2897">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-27-hutton-essex-uk-08-26-01d2897/ hutton-essex-uk-08-26-01], DeckTech (Phat "Phat2" Two, 27 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-27-hutton-essex-uk-08-26-01d2897/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
